set.body: PRD A-16. After rel-audit establishes pre-publication readiness, publish the agreed library modules for JVM and Scala.js to Maven Central. Record version, coordinates, source/tree and artifact digests, then independently resolve and run public consumers from Central without publishLocal/sibling overrides. Attach final publication evidence to the A-1..A-27 matrix; first-release compatibility verification remains in rel-mima. Source-branch qualification and local consumer publication alone do not establish this acceptance.
